hypothesis: structured step-by-step scoring beats direct answering on held-out arithmetic for every local model family tested, at a sample size pre-specified to detect a 0.10 difference
methods:
RD="$PWD"; ROOT=""; d="$RD"; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do [ -d "$d/src/ai_researcher" ] && { ROOT="$d"; break; }; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || { echo "no repo root" >&2; exit 1; }; # 1. rebuild the disjoint item bank, refusing to write it if any invariant fails
PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/src" python3 "$ROOT/demo/transfer/build_confirm_set.py" --n 160 --seed 20261010 || exit 1
# 2. the scorer must pass its own self-test or nothing runs
PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/src:$ROOT/demo/shared" python3 "$ROOT/demo/transfer/run_confirmation.py" --selftest || exit 1
# 3. measure
PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/src:$ROOT/demo/shared" EVO_OUT="$RD/artifacts" EVO_SEED=20261010 EVO_MODELS="qwen2.5:7b,gemma3:4b" python3 "$ROOT/demo/transfer/run_confirmation.py"

kill_switch.note: gain replicates: extend to more families or more items
no replicable gain: restrict the claim to the conditions actually tested
direction unresolvable at this n: report intervals, do not claim an effect

approved_by: liuzewen (blanket 全做 2026-10-08; prospective confirmation, disjoint 160-item bank, n=320 paired)
tension: The only effect in this project that survives project-level multiplicity correction (2 of 8 primary endpoints) is the arithmetic transfer result -- and it was measured on two arms whose verdict was analyst-assigned, because matrix-01's preregistered kill-switch keyed on a field its harness never emitted, so the preregistered rule never ran. A surviving result whose decision rule was assigned after seeing the data is not a confirmed result. Confirming it prospectively, at an n chosen by a power calculation rather than by what fit in a session, is the difference between a finding and an observation. If the effect does not reproduce prospectively at n=320 with a kill-switch that runs, the honest outcome is that this project's single surviving effect was an artifact of unpreregistered analysis.
